post.hook: An LLM rewrote another model's weights
post.subhook: Plus Anthropic's RSI warning and ~400 apps hiding deepfake tools

stories.headline: MIT uses GPT-6 Astra to edit Qwen's open weights directly
stories.detail: One LLM edited an open model's weights and raised its math benchmark score, a new technique for modifying open models.

stories.headline: Claude Code will no longer clone existing video games
stories.detail: Anthropic updated Claude Code's system prompt to stop it re-creating existing games, while still allowing game development.

stories.headline: Anthropic plans a trail showing when text was made with AI
stories.detail: Claude output will carry a provenance signal that reveals AI authorship, which could change how text is verified.

stories.headline: Anthropic warns it is very close to recursive self-improvement
stories.detail: The report describes a warning that AI is near training itself, not a shipped capability. It matters for safety planning.

stories.headline: Hundreds of mundane AI apps hide abusive deepfake features
stories.detail: WIRED found roughly 400 apps and sites with hidden features for generating sexually abusive and violent AI images and video.

stories.headline: OpenAI pilots grid program to free up to 1,000 MW in emergencies
stories.detail: The Grid Protectors Program, run with utilities at a Georgia data center, aims to protect nearby electricity costs.

stories.headline: OpenAI ups bug bounties, plans security sprint with Cathedral
stories.detail: Outside researchers are invited in and rewards for critical findings are going up.

stories.headline: NYT and publishers sue Brave over AI scraping, paywall bypass
stories.detail: The suit alleges scraped content is distributed to AI companies, which could shape how publisher content is licensed.

stories.headline: xAI cuts Grok Bot usage limits over high costs
stories.detail: Usage limits on the AI agent are being reduced because of operating costs.

post.caption:
One LLM edited another model's weights today, and it worked.

1. MIT researchers used GPT-6 Astra to edit Qwen's open weights directly, raising a math benchmark score. (Latent Space)
2. Anthropic updated Claude Code's system prompt so it won't re-create existing video games; game development is still allowed. (The Verge)
3. Anthropic says Claude output will carry a trail showing it was made with AI. (Yahoo Finance)
4. Anthropic warns it is very close to recursive self-improvement capability. It's a warning, not a shipped feature. (TechCrunch)
5. Roughly 400 mundane-looking AI apps and sites hide features for generating abusive deepfake images and video. (WIRED)

Briefs:
6. OpenAI's Grid Protectors Program pilots freeing up to 1,000 MW during emergencies at a Georgia data center. (OpenAI)
7. OpenAI is partnering with Cathedral on a security sprint and raising bug bounty rewards. (OpenAI)
8. The NYT and other publishers are suing Brave over alleged AI scraping and paywall bypass. (The Verge)
9. xAI is cutting Grok Bot usage limits, citing high costs. (TechCrunch)

That's the day. Back tomorrow.
